messages:
Carmen Ruiz: quick one  manager prepping an IC->Sr IC promo but HR says it still needs calibration panel. manager asked: does that mean we can't publish comp until panel signs off? also employee is planning an internal move UK->US right after promo - how do we handle comp band + taxes?
Leo Park: short: calibration decides final level and comp band. you can prepare a comp proposal but don't finalize offers or payroll changes until panel outcome. for relocation, compensation should reflect new location band starting on the move effective date; tax withholding follows country of work. if promo effective date is before relocation, handle as normal then convert for move.
Kai Nakamura: to add: if panel bumps level up, comp-ops will re-run bands and may recommend a counter-offer to maintain internal parity. managers should include peer comp context in the packet if concerned about compression.
Carmen Ruiz: manager also asked whether we can provide a ballpark USD figure before panel so candidate can plan relocation. is that allowed?
CompOps: yes provide a ballpark range marked "estimate, pending calibration". include floor/mid/ceiling and note FX assumptions. recommended language: "Estimated base: $Xk-$Yk (pending calibration and final approval)." do not promise sign-on until approved.
Carmen Ruiz: what about retro if promo effective date is the day before relocation and payroll runs in different countries? any gotchas?
Leo Park: payroll note: retro pay follows the payroll jurisdiction where the employee was paid during the retro period. If the retro spans two jurisdictions, payroll will split calculations and apply local tax rules. Ask payroll early; this often triggers manual processing.
Kai Nakamura: checklist for manager to include in the calibration packet:
```
- Promo Evidence form (1-page bullets linking to rubric axes)
- Comp proposal (currency + USD equivalent; floor/mid/ceiling estimates)
- Peer comp snapshot (anonymized)
- Relocation plan + effective move date
- Expected retro estimate and reason if applicable
- Org chart and before/after role bullets
- Links to 2 key PRs and a short metric (dates + dashboard links)
```
